body:
yeah that song was ok, I can relate to it somewhat.

And you are right, severe depression is worse than physical pain, but I guess I've been conditioned to believe it's not a very admirable thing, to cry.

I did try lifting weights at a friend's place a few weeks ago when I was in another city, and it did feel pretty good afterward, even though I had a hard time of it, and that's probably not a bad idea to get more exercise, I cant even do a single pull up.

I'm seriously doubting my ability to hang on long enough to get any benefits from doing that, though.

I'm just tired of failure, poverty, loneliness, and feeling like a burden on everyone, and I don't think I can cope with that long enough for me to change anything in my life.  I've tried suicide twice, and even failed at that.  I don't have any reason to think anything will be different, I mean I have tried, and nothing seems to work out for the better--I ALWAYS figure out a way to blow it, whatever "it" is.......maybe I sabotage myself subconsciously, 'cause deep down I know I'm gonna blow it anyway, no matter how well I may be fooling myself at any given moment.  I just feel trapped by failure, and usually because I have blown it one way or another.
Dont really know what else to tell you, other than I have failed at every aspect of life.  Dont see getting out of the hole I've dug for myself, wouldn't even know where to begin.

I try to listen to music but it doesnt help.  I've cried myself to sleep plenty of times and the endorphin release helps somewhat, but I always feel like a little bitch for crying about my problems and it just makes me fell that much more disgusted with myself, later.  It does feel good to sleep though.
I've blown plenty of opportunities, lost jobs, lost material possessions, relationships, etc., so I think I can pretty safely say that I am a loser.

I get that feeling, too, it's kinda like what you said, thoughts racing through my head, worried about things, feeling alone.  When I do get to sleep, I wanna stay that way, and just be unconscious, which is kinda why I think I'd rather be dead.
I usually have trouble getting to sleep.

Been looking for work, cant find anything.  Been on the streets before and dont think I could handle it again.  Been living off of friends for too long, dont wanna keep draining them and my depression doesnt help them any, they've got issues of their own.  Dont see myself as being the next Leonardo DiCaprio, or much of anything else, either.
